title: BHMarketer Street Insider FAQ Generator: Question Search and FAQ Schema Generation for Street Insider Press Releases
description: The BHMarketer Street Insider FAQ Generator is a question search tool for BHMarketer.ai's Street Insider press release service. A user types a question in plain English and the tool returns the matching official answer from 35 FAQs with a match-confidence score from 0 to 100. It also generates the FAQ, in full or by category, as Markdown, JSON, FAQPage JSON-LD or HTML. Covers pricing (standard packages from around $35 to $50), editorial rules, timelines, Google News, SEO and AI search visibility, post-publication edits and support. Includes identical TypeScript (NPM) and Python implementations, a 35-entry FAQ dataset and a 35-question search benchmark. Not affiliated with Street Insider. Built by BHMarketer.ai.
